title: Code Review Simulator: Diegetic OS Light Mode
body:
Working on light mode for Code Review Simulator's diegetic OS.

A look at the terminal, Tetris, E-Shop, and city map on the in-game desktop.

![QTerm showing its command reference above the light-mode desktop taskbar in Code Review Simulator.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-10-03-diegetic-os-light-mode/qterm-light-mode.png)

![Tetris on the in-game desktop, with a dark playfield, light controls, and the light-mode taskbar.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-10-03-diegetic-os-light-mode/tetris-light-mode.png)

![The light-mode E-Shop displaying a grid of PC components, prices, and hardware categories.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-10-03-diegetic-os-light-mode/e-shop-light-mode.png)

![The light-mode city map showing crossroads, Home, Mart, building markers, and navigation controls.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-10-03-diegetic-os-light-mode/city-map-light-mode.png)
